_comment: Historical policies whose lever values are known from statute. This file
defines the EVIDENCE BASE in policy-lever space: a requested policy_spec is
reported as in_support only if it sits near at least one of these.
Every entry carries a statutory citation. Lever values are read off the
statute, not estimated. Where a policy has no analogue for a lever, the
lever takes the neutral value (0 for credits/transfers, infinity for a
phaseout threshold that does not exist).
This is NOT the opinion evidence file. data/evidence.json holds survey
crosstabs used for poststratification; this file holds policy parameters
used to decide whether a proposal is inside the evidence base at all.
